hero.subtitle: Masonry Works · Prague
hero.title: LELE STAV
hero.description: We are an innovative construction company that builds not just houses, but stories. Your reliable partner in creating solid foundations, durable structures and spaces full of character.

about.subtitle: About Us
about.title: Who are we?
about.description1: We are a long-established, stable company specialising in all types of masonry and construction works. From tile and paving installation, drywall assembly, electrical works and facade finishing to full renovations, plumbing, heating and turnkey construction.
about.description2: Our team consists exclusively of experienced professionals in their field. Every member is carefully selected based on skills, experience and passion for construction. Your projects are in the hands of experts with years of practice.
about.feature1_desc: Our work is our art. We uphold the highest quality standards so that every detail of your project is perfect.
about.feature2_desc: With us you get not just a building, but years of accumulated expertise. Your project will be delivered with precision and deep professional knowledge.
about.feature3_desc: We meet deadlines. With us you won't face unnecessary delays. Every project is a commitment we fully honour.

services.subtitle: What we do
services.title: Our Services
services.description: We offer a complete range of construction services — from minor repairs to full project delivery. Every project is approached individually and with maximum care.
services.s1_desc: Comprehensive construction solutions, whether you're planning a new build, renovation or repair. Covers all phases — from design to completion. From the first idea down to the last detail.
services.s2_desc: High-quality and precise tile and paving work. Thanks to years of experience and a professional approach we are ready to realise your project — whether a bathroom, living space or terrace.
services.s3_desc: Every facade we create is unique. Our speciality is energy-efficient thermal insulation that improves the building's thermal properties, reduces heating costs and increases comfort.
services.s4_desc: We carry out electrical installation work with maximum safety and precision. We also take care of elegant design solutions that fit perfectly into your interior.
services.s5_desc: We install water supply systems with a focus on energy efficiency. Thanks to innovative water management solutions we significantly reduce your costs and guarantee reliable operation.
services.s6_desc: Our heating systems are designed for maximum durability and efficiency. We use the latest technologies that minimise energy consumption while maintaining optimal temperature.

whyus.subtitle: Why choose us?
whyus.title: Professional construction solutions for your projects
whyus.r1_desc: A team of exclusively experienced professionals with years of practice. Every project you entrust to us is handled by true experts.
whyus.r2_desc: Every piece of our work is backed by a quality and customer satisfaction guarantee. We use only proven materials and technologies.
whyus.r3_desc: We always deliver work on the agreed schedule. Your time is our priority and work without unnecessary delays is our standard.
